title: Shadow Walk
html:
Not to be confused with Shadow Step
Shadow Walk is a Shadow Magic sorcerer class action granted at level 11. It allows a sorcerer to teleport into shadow and cast a spell at a distance without using sorcery points.

Description

Teleport into the shadows. The next spell you cast that turn will benefit from  Distant Spell without costing any Sorcery Points.

Properties

Cost
 Bonus Action
Details
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Targets: Obscured location

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 11: Shadow Magic

Notes

  • Unlike the similar Way of Shadow monk ability  Shadow Step, only the target location must be in shadow ( Lightly Obscured or  Heavily Obscured). The starting position can be a  Clear Area.
  • The free effect of  Metamagic: Distant Spell granted by this action stacks with any other metamagic effect (other than Distant Spell itself). Normally, multiple metamagic effects cannot be applied to the same spell.

Related features

  • Shadow Step - Similar action available to Way of Shadow monks at level 6
  • Shadow Teleport (Meazel) - Similar action used by meazels
  • Shadow Teleport (Meenlock) - Similar action used by meenlocks
  • Shadow Teleportation - Similar action granted by the  Dark Justiciar Boots
